data.long_meaning: A Greek name meaning 'gift of God' or 'dew'. Derived from the Greek 'doron', meaning 'gift', and 'inda', meaning 'dew'. In mythology, Dorinda is the name of a nymph who lived in a cave and bestowed her blessings upon those who discovered her. The name Dorinda carries the meaning “Dew, Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Dorinda usually hope their child will grow to embody dew, gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: דֹּרִינְדָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דֹּרִינְדָה היא שמה העברי לציור יפה, ומקורו בעברית עתיקה. השם נועד לעזור לילדה להיות יפה, ומלאה, ולהיות כמו ספינה, יציבה וסגורה. דורינדה, כמו כל שם עברי, חוזרת ומתחדשת בכל דור ודור, והיא חלק ממורשת יהודית-נוצרית.

in_greek.name: Δωρίνδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Δωρίνδα είναι το ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει εύκολος, ευκίνητος, και σωτήριος. Η καταγωγή του ονόματος είναι από την αρχαία Ελλάδα, όπου το όνομα συνδέεται με τον θεό Δώριο. Στη Βίβλο, το όνομα δεν είναι αναφέρεται. Ωστόσο, το όνομα έχει μια στενή σχέση με τον Χριστιανισμό, καθώς αναφέρεται σε μια γυναίκα που έγινε křesiane. Το όνομα έχει μια ισχυρή προφορά, και είναι ένα κομψό και αξιόπιστο όνομα.

in_latin.name: Dorinda
in_latin.long_meaning: Dorinda est nomen Latinum quod significat bona, dora, dulcis, et forma. Origo nominis est a lingua Latina antiqua, ubi nomen coniunctum est cum deae Veneri. In Biblia, nomen non est referetur. Tamen, nomen habet relationem apertam cum Christianismo, quia referitur ad mulierem qui facta est christiana. Nomen habet sonum fortissimum, et est nomen elegans et fidelis.

in_english.name: Dorinda
in_english.long_meaning: Dorinda is a Christian name that originates from the Hebrew word 'Dor' meaning gift, and 'Inda' meaning beautiful form. The name is not found in the Bible, but it has a strong connection with Christianity as it is associated with a woman who became Christian. The name has a strong pronunciation and is a beautiful and elegant name. It is also associated with the virtues of being a gift, sweet, and having a beautiful form. In modern times, the name Dorinda has been used in various cultures and languages, including English, Spanish, and Italian. It is a popular name among Christians and is often given to girls born into Christian families.
